releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.52 moves Settings back to the persistent bottom navigation as a fifth tab: Home, Files, Notes, Library and Settings. The shared Home/Files/Notes/Library identity header is now clean and consistent with no Settings gear, and the old floating Settings overlay that caused doubled gears is removed. Five-tab sizing is tightened for phone screens while My Places, Library/Inbox, Price Photos duplicate protection and the stable Instagram save/Gallery flow remain intact.
